scope: Static-mode frontend under repository subpath, with API-mode transport retained.

runs.dataset: 52 explicitly labelled synthetic event fixtures; 318 authoritative catalog links and 6 curated subscription descriptors copied read-only from repository configuration.

cases.observed: CUA opened /CMUEvents/. app.js, data-client.js, styles.css, favicon.svg and all four data JSON requests stayed under that base.
52 explicitly labelled temporary fixture events; page one displayed 24.
Next displayed 25–48 of 52; browser pathname remained /CMUEvents/.
robotics + School of Computer Science + Online produced 17 fixture events without errors.
2026-11-01 through 2026-11-03 reduced the same filters to 4 fixture events; no date error.
The selected fixture retained its complete description and original event URL in the native detail drawer.
Show all displayed 318 cards and 318 original source links.
All 6 curated email channels displayed; boundary says subscriber emails are not imported, public calendar events may appear.
Reload published events retained active filters and 17 matching events; toast confirmed published data reload.
Temporary HTTP server request log contained GET manifest/events/sources/status for initial load and manual reload, with no POST or API request.
A new publication generation paired with successful collection time 2026-10-20 displayed Published data may be out of date and more than 48 hours old.
Footer DOM exposes https://github.com/OranSimon/CMUEvents with accessible Source code on GitHub label.

alumni.error: Alumni public DOM discovery requires CMUEVENTS_RENDER_PUBLIC=1; fixed reviewed-card snapshots are not a live fallback
Alumni public DOM discovery requires CMUEVENTS_RENDER_PUBLIC=1; fixed reviewed-card snapshots are not a live fallback

limitations.meaning: This isolated local build intentionally disabled public browser rendering. The two Alumni sources remain explicit errors with zero imported events and no fixed reviewed-card fallback. GitHub Actions renderer coverage is not established by this local run.

queryParity.searchRankingDifference: Static ranking uses deterministic title/publisher weights; SQLite uses BM25. Membership and counts are compared independently of ranking.

transport.qualification: Execute the identical shipped static data client against the real preview, with fetch request logging; CUA separately confirmed the actual browser Reload success.

cases.observed: CUA default Upcoming displayed 3,642, distinct from the 4,389 events in the full export.
Next displayed 25–48 of 3,642 events under /CMUEvents/.
robot search returned 121; School of Computer Science reduced this to 10; November 1–30 reduced it to 5 without date errors.
Oren Etzioni lecture retained November 18, 2026, 5:15–6:15 PM EST, Rashid Auditorium, two organizer/source labels and original links. Expanding full description showed 328 words.
Reload published events completed successfully and retained robot, School of Computer Science, November 1–30 and 5 matching events. No local-API message or error appeared.
Show all rendered 318 cards, 318 unique source IDs and 318 original links outside collapsed diagnostics.
Alumni + Needs review showed exactly the two renderer-disabled source rows. Expanded diagnostics state CMUEVENTS_RENDER_PUBLIC=1 is required and fixed snapshots are not a live fallback.

Email directory displayed 6 channels: 4 email-only and 2 public-calendar plus email. Public-email filter showed Nexus and PDL. Boundary explicitly excludes subscriber-only email while allowing public-calendar coverage.
Closing email restored focus to subscriptions-button and preserved the main robot/date/department filters and 5-event result.

CUA visually inspected the actual export in a measured 390×844 iframe. All three navigation entries and Reload were visible; the daily/last-success notice fit; the Email panel opened from the small-screen nav with a full-width search and three labelled filters. No visible horizontal clipping was found.
The real exported page exposes Source code on GitHub linking to https://github.com/OranSimon/CMUEvents.

realExportValidation.note: No frozen frontend files were changed during real-export acceptance.

apiModeValidation.liveBrowser: Not repeated during this static task because parent-owned API server was stopped; previous UI task verified live API behavior.

production.deployment: Actual GitHub Pages URL is outside this local-preview verification; this run validates the real dist artifact.
